# `setup` commands

## `setup`

Set up Bookflow for an AI agent in one step: the data root and its owner, a company with a chart of accounts, the agent's own identity working for the owner, its MCP client configuration and token file, a one-time link for the owner to set a password in the browser, and the host running in the background. Rerunning it repairs what is missing and reports the rest; it never makes anything twice.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | hub |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | the local operating-system login, which becomes or already is the installation's administrator |
| Capability | setup |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | Local only; no HTTP route. |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow setup --company "Green Valley Landscaping" --currency USD --owner dana --owner-name "Dana Ruiz" --json`

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `company` | `--company` | string | yes | no | — | The company's legal name; also its organization's name; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `currency` | `--currency` | string | no | no | "USD" | Home currency, ISO 4217 upper case; minimum length 3; maximum length 3; pattern "^[A-Z]{3}$" |
| `chart` | `--chart` | literal["general", "service", "product", "contractor", "retail", "nonprofit"] | no | no | "general" | Packaged chart of accounts to start from |
| `owner` | `--owner` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The owner's username; defaults to this computer's login |
| `owner_name` | `--owner-name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The owner's name as people see it |
| `agent` | `--agent` | string | no | no | "assistant" | Username for the AI agent's own identity; minimum length 1; maximum length 64 |
| `agent_name` | `--agent-name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The agent's name in lists and the audit trail; defaults to Assistant |
| `role` | `--role` | literal["readonly", "standard", "admin"] \| null | no | yes | null | The agent's role in the company: standard for a new agent; given for an existing one, it changes the role |
| `mcp_config` | `--mcp-config` | string | no | no | ".mcp.json" | MCP client configuration file to write or update (the `bookflow` server entry only); minimum length 1 |
| `bind` | `--bind` | string | no | no | "127.0.0.1:8765" | Address the host listens on, host:port (loopback); maximum length 128 |
| `serve` | `--serve` | boolean | no | no | true | Start the host in the background if it is not answering, and wait until it does |
| `link_minutes` | `--link-minutes` | integer | no | no | 120 | Minutes the owner's one-time password link stays valid; minimum 1; maximum 1440 |
| `new_token` | `--new-token` | boolean | no | no | false | Issue the agent a new token even though its last one was revoked; a person's decision |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |

### HTTP

This command has no HTTP route.

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | no | false | — |
| `warnings` | array[string] | no | no | [] | — |
| `data_root` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `owner` | object[string, any] | yes | no | — | user_id, username and display_name of the person setup ran for |
| `company` | object[string, any] | yes | no | — | company_id, display_name, home_currency and organization_id |
| `agent` | object[string, any] | yes | no | — | user_id, username and role of the agent's own identity, and the principal it acts for |
| `mcp_config` | string | yes | no | — | The MCP client configuration file written |
| `mcp_server` | object[string, any] | yes | no | — | The `bookflow` server entry in it: command, args and env (no secret) |
| `token_file` | string | yes | no | — | Owner-only file holding the agent's bearer; the configuration points at it |
| `url` | string | yes | no | — | Where the host answers; GET <url>health returns 200 once it is ready |
| `host` | object[string, any] | yes | no | — | status (running, started, not_started), pid and log |
| `owner_link` | object[string, any] \| null | yes | yes | — | url and expires_at of the owner's one-time password link; null when they have a password |
| `steps` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `steps[].step` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `steps[].status` | literal["created", "exists", "updated", "skipped", "stopped"] | yes | no | — | — |
| `steps[].detail` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `next_steps` | array[string] | yes | no | — | — |
| `content` | string | yes | no | — | The same result as plain text, for a person |
| `media_type` | string | no | no | "text/plain" | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "agent": {},
  "company": {},
  "content": "value",
  "data_root": "/example",
  "dry_run": false,
  "host": {},
  "mcp_config": "value",
  "mcp_server": {},
  "media_type": "text/plain",
  "next_steps": [],
  "owner": {},
  "owner_link": null,
  "steps": [],
  "token_file": "value",
  "url": "value",
  "warnings": []
}
```

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_INIT_CONFLICT` | The data root is already initialized for a different user. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_NOT_ALLOWED` | Binding outside loopback needs --allow-network. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
